name: eval-e24_i2
intent: 复古双色调印刷海报感：抽象几何底图，画面转为深蓝与米白双色，带浮雕纹理线条

params: Use a stable broad fractal field as the abstract source artwork
Create strong light-dark separation before geometric simplification
Bias the field toward substantial deep-blue shadow areas
Keep the source structures broad enough to become readable poster blocks
Limit fine detail so the base remains graphic rather than photographic
Retain a little uneven print-like variation inside the larger forms
Divide the artwork into clear vertical geometric block columns
Create a complementary set of broad horizontal block rows
Force crisp hard-edged cells for a printed geometric-poster construction
Restrict the geometry to a bold limited-tone print structure
Keep the graphic tonal banding fully visible
Light the printed relief from upper-left for coherent stamped edges
Make block boundaries visibly raised and carved without destroying their silhouettes
Give the relief lines crisp ink-and-paper contrast
Preserve enough of the poster block fill beneath the embossed ridge detail
Map all dark ink and embossed shadows to deep navy blue
Map paper highlights and relief ridges to warm cream
Enforce the deep-blue and cream duotone across the entire composition
Prevent any original full-color source from leaking through

_rationale: Fractal Noise supplies a broad abstract field, while Mosaic and Posterize turn it into immediately readable hard-edged geometric print blocks. Emboss creates directional pressed-paper linework before Tint locks every resulting tone into a cohesive deep-navy and warm-cream poster palette.
pass_criteria: strict two-tone palette (deep blue + cream), no full-color leakage

applied.why: 将几何底图限制为黑白两级，减少进入Tint前的中间灰阶，帮助消除目前占画面大面积的第三种灰褐色。
提高与原始二级图形的混合，保留深蓝和米白的大块双色基础，同时仍留下部分Emboss边缘作为压印线条，而非让浮雕生成的中灰覆盖画面。
收窄浮雕高度/宽度，使压印集中在几何边界附近，减少目前粗大的双轨线条，并让边缘更像纸面压印。
